tests.name: Desktop final-subpath HTTP, nonblank UI and real WebGL 2
Picking a rendered sphere selects it; pointer dragging orbits real geometry
True scale diminishes Earth, returns to readable scale
Body selection changes facts and flies to real sphere
Time scrub, playback, speed and pause actually change model time
Nine-stop tour, body flights and final true-scale reveal
Street table uses one physical ratio; validation and recalculation
Mobile actual homepage, readable responsive layout and no overflow
Mobile touch drag moves the three-dimensional camera
Mobile true scale, touch body selection and keyboard-operable controls
Mobile tour works and returns to Explore
Reduced motion has immediate scale and camera transition
No-WebGL fallback retains accessible educational facts and street model
No console/page/request/HTTP errors across all contexts

visualEvidence.desktop: 已打开实际 1200×900 PNG：衬线标题与金色强调有清晰层次；椭圆轨道、真实球体与右侧事实面板留白均衡，底部时间和天体控件可辨识。暗背景文字对比清晰，无内容截断或横向溢出。
visualEvidence.mobile: 已打开实际 390×844 PNG：标题、缩放后的三维轨道及事实区形成单列阅读；尺度控件随纵向滚动可达，天体选择条局部横向滚动而非整页溢出。字体层次与边距保持一致。
visualEvidence.preview: 已另行打开 ensurePreview 新生成的 1200×900 实际首屏，与已检查的桌面布局一致，无错误页、空白或占位截图。
